paper.title_en: Towards the Search for Lepton Flavor Violating \(B\rightarrow K\tau \ell \) Decays at Belle and Belle II
paper.abstract_en:
<jats:p>The \(B \rightarrow K\tau \ell \) decays (where \(\ell =e,\mu \)) are not allowed in the Standard Model (SM) at the tree level due to lepton flavor violation (LFV). In some New Physics (NP) models, their branching fractions are within the reach of the current experimental sensitivities. The Belle and Belle II experiments provide ideal conditions for their search. We used the basic kinematic constraints of the experiments to reconstruct them. A multivariate classifier score is used to model the signal and background. For the estimation of statistical upper limits (ULs), the Bayesian approach is used. To validate the analysis method, two control channel modes are used.</jats:p>
